evidence.quote:
requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: Mandating a signed manifest before shipping appeals to security and process integrity — conservation of safe deployment and competence of craft.

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Framing the gate as justified by prior security failures appeals to conservation — preventing recurrence of unsafe artifacts.
Declaring a required signed manifest restates the conservation-and-competence gate as a formal rule.
Extending the gate's scope to both staging and production broadens the security-conservation boundary.
Naming an owner asserts self-origination and accountability — the autonomy need of owning a process.

mints.name: GateAsSecurityMandate
mints.title: signed release manifest required before it ships
mints.frame: Is the value move here appealing to security and process integrity as a mandatory gate, rather than merely describing a deployment step?
